items.description: Landlord and Tenant must sign an amendment reflecting Tenant's exercise of its right to lease a Datacenter Expansion Area.
items.span_text: If Tenant duly exercises its right to lease a Datacenter Expansion Area, Landlord and Tenant shall execute an amendment reflecting such exercise.
items.trigger: If Tenant duly exercises its right to lease a Datacenter Expansion Area

items.description: If Tenant disagrees with Landlord's designated Prevailing Base Rent, Tenant must request arbitration in its Datacenter Expansion Exercise Notice, or it is deemed to accept Landlord's designation.
items.span_text: Tenant shall request that the determination of Prevailing Base Rent for the Datacenter Expansion Area be submitted to arbitration in accordance with the procedure set forth below in Section 1.8.2
items.trigger: If Tenant disagrees with Landlord’s designation of the Prevailing Base Rent set forth in Landlord’s Datacenter Offer

items.anchor_event: Tenant’s delivery to Landlord of Tenant’s Datacenter Expansion Exercise Notice
items.description: Each party must give the other written notice naming its selected Disinterested Expert within ten business days after Tenant's exercise notice.
items.span_text: each party shall give written notice to the other setting forth the name and address of the Disinterested Expert selected by such party

items.description: Each party bears the cost of its own Disinterested Expert and half the cost of any third expert.
items.span_text: Each party shall pay for the cost of its Disinterested Expert and one-half of the cost of any 3rd Expert.

items.description: After arbitration sets the Base Rent, Tenant must pay any underpayment to Landlord within thirty calendar days after billing.
items.span_text: (i) Tenant shall, within thirty (30) calendar days after billing, pay to Landlord any underpayment of Base Rent
items.trigger: If the Base Rent for the Datacenter Expansion Area shall not have been determined prior to the commencement date with respect to such Datacenter Expansion Area

items.description: After arbitration sets the Base Rent, Landlord must credit Tenant's account for any overpayment of Base Rent.
items.span_text: (ii) Landlord shall credit to Tenant’s account any overpayment of Base Rent
items.trigger: If the Base Rent for the Datacenter Expansion Area shall not have been determined prior to the commencement date with respect to such Datacenter Expansion Area

items.description: Landlord must obtain, at its own cost, the licenses and permits it needs to perform the Essential Services and Landlord's Installations.
items.span_text: Landlord shall, at Landlord’s cost, obtain all licenses, approvals, permits and authorizations required by applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations that Landlord is required to have in order to perform the Landlord’s Essential Services and to perform Landlord’s Installations.

items.description: Landlord must give Tenant copies of the licenses and permits within ten business days after Tenant requests them.
items.span_text: Landlord shall provide Tenant with all such licenses, approvals, permits and authorizations within ten (10) business days after Landlord’s receipt of Tenant’s request therefore.

items.description: Tenant's obligation to pay Rent starts on the Commencement Date.
items.span_text: Tenant’s obligation to pay Rent under this Lease, shall commence on the Commencement Date

items.description: Landlord must use commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy the Commencement Date Conditions before the Target Commencement Date.
items.span_text: Landlord shall use commercially reasonable efforts to satisfy the Commencement Date Conditions prior to the Target Commencement Date.

items.description: If the Commencement Date Conditions are late beyond the Outside Liquidated Damages Date, Tenant receives a Rent Credit per day of delay, with the credit rate redacted.
items.span_text: Tenant shall receive a credit (“Rent Credit”) of [***] days of Rent
items.trigger: If the Commencement Date Conditions have not occurred prior to the Outside Liquidated Damages Date, subject to extension by virtue of Force Majeure

items.description: Deadline for appointing Disinterested Experts, counted from Tenant's delivery of its Datacenter Expansion Exercise Notice.
items.name: Appointment Deadline
